newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Farm ministers to discuss new hop aid scheme.
newsitem.headline: Farm ministers to discuss new hop aid scheme.

text.p: Farm ministers will try on Tuesday to agree a simplified aid system for hop producers to help them become more competitive, EU officials said.
The European Commission has proposed to phase in a single area aid hop premium over five years to replace payments for aromatic and bitter varieties.
Britain, Italy, Sweden and Denmark support the Commission's proposal for a flat-rate aid of 450 ecus per hectare over five years.
But Germany, Austria, Spain and Belgium are pressing for aid of over 500 hectares.
The new Luxembourg EU Presidency will try to win support for a compromise of 480 ecus per hectare.
The Commission also wants to allocate five percent of aid to encourage producers to switch to more marketable varieties.
